rows.text: copies 9 rows of 16 bytes from argument 1 (rows dword argument 2 apart, sign-extended) into an aligned stack block; with word filters H = the 32 bytes at `01CDC060` + 32*argument 3 and V = those at `01CDC060` + 32*argument 4, it forms for each stack row h = (b[i]*H0 + b[i+1]*H1 + 64) >> 7 over its first 8 bytes and their right neighbours (16-bit `pmullw`, arithmetic `psraw`, the 64s from `03001000`), and writes each output row as (h_previous*V0 + h*V1 + 64) >> 7 packed to bytes with unsigned saturation, 8 bytes at argument 5, rows dword argument 6 apart (sign-extended), until 8 rows are written; it saves and restores `xmm6`/`xmm7`
